text: 🇲🇽⚖️ "Direct meeting with CNTE is totally ruled out." "A meeting is totally ruled out. In any case, there is the Interior Ministry and the Education Ministry." — President Sheinbaum on the teachers' union request, June 16 mañanera The CNTE asked again for a direct presidential meeting. Sheinbaum: dialogue runs through Segob and SEP. Tripartite tables at state level, permanent technical committees, and an August consultation on the magisterial career reform. Real dialogue, not theater.

🇲🇽✊ "Exceptional public servants who love Mexico." "My applause, my recognition, my admiration — they are exceptional public servants who love Mexico." — President Sheinbaum, recognizing the security cabinet Harfuch (SSPC), Rosa Icela (Interior), Figueroa Franco (SESNSP), plus Defense, Navy and Guardia Nacional. First time in decades the strategy runs on civilian coordination and intelligence — not militarization or foreign intervention.

🇲🇽🎨 200,000 new high school seats added nationwide. "200,000 new educational spaces are being added to pursue Bachillerato across the country." — Interior Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez, June 16 mañanera High school became a constitutional right in 2019. For decades the neoliberal governments left that right unfunded. The 4T is building the preparatorias and paying for them.

🇲🇽✊ 11,139 firearms turned in — anonymously, for cash. "The population has exchanged 11,139 firearms for cash, in a completely anonymous way." — Interior Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez, June 16 mañanera "Sí al Desarme, Sí a la Paz" runs through parishes and public plazas. Walk in with a weapon, walk out with cash, no questions. While US gun lobbies fight every regulation, Mexico buys the guns back to destroy them.

🇲🇽🔍 Homicides down 46% — 39 fewer killings every day. "A 46 percent decrease has been recorded in the national daily average of intentional homicide. That represents 39 fewer homicides every day." — Omar García Harfuch, Security Secretary, June 16 mañanera September 2024: 86.9 daily homicides. May 2026: 47.3. Lowest monthly average in 12 years. Strategy: intelligence, root-cause programs, federal-state coordination. No militarization Calderón-style, no foreign troops.

🇲🇽⚽ Felipe VI in Mexico City for the World Cup. "It's probable, Foreign Relations is still working on it." — President Sheinbaum on a likely June 26 meeting with the King of Spain The King travels to Mexico for Spain's World Cup group-stage match. The meeting follows his March acknowledgment of "much abuse" during the Conquest, and Sheinbaum's April trip to Madrid for a progressive leaders' summit.

🚨🇲🇽 Mexico to US DOJ: no evidence, no extradition. "What a US Department of Justice office requested was urgent detention for extradition purposes. We have said there is no evidence for urgent detention and no evidence has been delivered." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, June 16 mañanera The DOJ asked Mexico to detain Sinaloa governor Rubén Rocha Moya for extradition. Mexico replied: show the file. No deadline applies because no formal trial exists — only a urgent-detention request that arrived empty.

🇲🇽🛢️ MEXICAN CRUDE DROPS 5.15% TO $77.75 AS HORMUZ REOPENS — SHEINBAUM SAYS LOWER PRICES SHIELD FUEL SUBSIDIES

Mexican mezcla crude fell 5.15% to $77.75/barrel today — its lowest since March — after Trump and Iran reached a peace framework set for formal signing in Switzerland Friday. WTI dropped to $80.75 (-4.87%), Brent to $83.35 (-4.56%). The peso held firm near 17.20/dollar, on its 7th straight session of gains.

Sheinbaum at her mañanera: oil around $80 (down from over $110 during the war) actually helps Mexico's public finances because the government subsidizes gasoline and diesel via the IEPS — every dollar cheaper means less fiscal cost. Iran's resistance broke the blockade, the Strait of Hormuz reopens, and Mexican drivers come out ahead.

Source: El Financiero
